newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds must hold 108-17 for any gains.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds must hold 108-17 for any gains.

text.p: June T-bond futures are trapped in a range, but some upside gains may be possible if the contract can hold above the recent low of 108-17, technical analysts said on Thursday.
But a rally back up to the heavily congested area above 109-20 is unlikely, they said.

Andy Anderson, manager of strategic trading desk at Fuji Bank in London said the market could have another attempt at overcoming tough resistance at 109-06 and 109-12 after it failed to break 109-12 several times in the past week.
By 0940 GMT, the June T-bond contract was up 5/32 at 108-28.
"It's key for the market to maintain 108-17 today," said Anderson. "I think there's a good chance the market could go higher."
However, analysts said the most likely scenario for the contract was a short term period of sideways activity, as the range remained intact.
"I'm seeing consolidation within a range," said Raynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London. "The range is 108-17 to 109-12, with the middle at 108-28."
He said a break of that range would see the contract slide to 108-00, a level the market has not seen since April.
Last week, the June T-bond future was repeatedly thwarted in attempts to break above the 109-10/12 resistance barrier.
And on Wednesday, the market set a low of 108-18, following a low of 108-17 on Tuesday.
Analysts said large losses are not on the cards yet as momentum divergences have not been erased.
At the short end, September Eurodollars were likely to find their upward path blocked at 93.945, Wednesday's high. On the downside, steady support from previous lows was pegged at 93.915.
The contract was up one basis point at 93.935 by 1145 GMT.
